targetTexts.2: “Hear my words, O wise men; give ear to me, O men of learning.
targetTexts.3: For the ear tests words as the mouth tastes food.
targetTexts.4: Let us choose for ourselves what is right; let us learn together what is good.
targetTexts.5: For Job has declared, ‘I am righteous, yet God has deprived me of justice.
targetTexts.6: Would I lie about my case? My wound is incurable, though I am without transgression.’
targetTexts.7: What man is like Job, who drinks up derision like water?
targetTexts.8: He keeps company with evildoers and walks with wicked men.
targetTexts.9: For he has said, ‘It profits a man nothing that he should delight in God.’
targetTexts.10: Therefore listen to me, O men of understanding. Far be it from God to do wrong, and from the Almighty to act unjustly.
targetTexts.11: For according to a man’s deeds He repays him; according to a man’s ways He brings consequences.
targetTexts.12: Indeed, it is true that God does not act wickedly, and the Almighty does not pervert justice.
targetTexts.13: Who gave Him charge over the earth? Who appointed Him over the whole world?
targetTexts.14: If He were to set His heart to it and withdraw His Spirit and breath,
targetTexts.15: all flesh would perish together and mankind would return to the dust.
targetTexts.16: If you have understanding, hear this; listen to my words.
targetTexts.17: Could one who hates justice govern? Will you condemn the just and mighty One,
targetTexts.18: who says to kings, ‘You are worthless!’ and to nobles, ‘You are wicked,’
targetTexts.19: who is not partial to princes and does not favor rich over poor? For they are all the work of His hands.
targetTexts.20: They die in an instant, in the middle of the night. The people convulse and pass away; the mighty are removed without human hand.
targetTexts.21: For His eyes are on the ways of a man, and He sees his every step.
targetTexts.22: There is no darkness or deep shadow where the workers of iniquity can hide.
targetTexts.23: For God need not examine a man further or have him approach for judgment.
targetTexts.24: He shatters the mighty without inquiry and sets up others in their place.
targetTexts.25: Therefore, He recognizes their deeds; He overthrows them in the night and they are crushed.
targetTexts.26: He strikes them for their wickedness in full view,
targetTexts.27: because they turned aside from Him and had no regard for any of His ways.
targetTexts.28: They caused the cry of the poor to come before Him, and He heard the outcry of the afflicted.
targetTexts.29: But when He remains silent, who can condemn Him? When He hides His face, who can see Him? Yet He watches over both man and nation,
targetTexts.30: that godless men should not rule or lay snares for the people.
targetTexts.31: Suppose someone says to God, ‘I have endured my punishment; I will offend no more.
targetTexts.32: Teach me what I cannot see; if I have done wrong, I will not do it again.’
targetTexts.33: Should God repay you on your own terms when you have disavowed Him? You must choose, not I; so tell me what you know.
targetTexts.34: Men of understanding will declare to me, and the wise men who hear me will say:
targetTexts.35: ‘Job speaks without knowledge; his words lack insight.’
targetTexts.36: If only Job were tried to the utmost for answering like a wicked man.
targetTexts.37: For he adds rebellion to his sin; he claps his hands among us and multiplies his words against God.”
